board-minutes-of-meeting.1: Inside: legal rules, a copy-ready format and sample for a private limited company, and mistakes company secretaries see most often.
board-minutes-of-meeting.2: Board minutes of meeting are the official written record of a meeting of a company's board of directors. Attendance, quorum, business transacted, resolutions passed and any dissent all go in. Section 118(2) requires them to contain a fair and correct summary of the proceedings, and under Section 118(7) minutes kept properly are evidence of the proceedings recorded in them.
board-minutes-of-meeting.3: General meeting minutes cover shareholder meetings, while committee minutes cover board committees such as the audit committee. Board minutes differ from both.

board-minutes-of-meeting.21: The chairperson of the meeting signs the minutes, or the chairperson of the next meeting if needed. Usually the company secretary prepares them. Each meeting's minutes end with a dated, signed last page. Directors receive a certified copy of the signed minutes, so everyone works from one final record.
board-minutes-of-meeting.25: Yes. Companies may maintain minutes in electronic form subject to the applicable rules on security and signatures. Confirm the current requirements with your company secretary. Electronic minutes still need identical content, timelines and signatures to paper ones. Keep secure backups and an audit trail of who changed what.
